info.title: Wix REST APIs read by wp-woo-idempotent-importer
info.description: Wix publishes no OpenAPI document. This subset is transcribed by hand from the "REST API > Schema" block of each method page of Wix's official REST reference (fetched 2026-10-16; each schema and operation cites its page): only the responses the Wix adapter reads, with every property those pages document for them (opaque sub-objects the adapter keeps whole are left open). Required properties are the identifiers and the fields the adapter cannot do without. The blog posts reference lists the path as /v3/posts/query in its schema block and /blog/v3/posts/query in its examples; the examples' path (the one the blog categories method shares) is used.
